role.title: QA
role.description: Reviews stories in review, runs their tests and files bugs.

views.title: Stories assigned to me in review
views.query: project = {project} AND assignee = {me} AND status = 'In Review' ORDER BY updated DESC

views.title: Bugs I filed, open
views.query: project = {project} AND issuetype = Bug AND reporter = {me} AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
